tagline: Samoca取景器相机，1956 年发布
description: Samoca于1956年推出的取景器相机。配备C. EZUMAR Anastigmat coated, F/3.5/50mm。快门速度'Prontor type' shutter with speeds 1/10 to 1/200 sec and B.。使用35mm。

specs.快门: 'Prontor type' shutter with speeds 1/10 to 1/200 sec and B.
specs.英文简介: The Samoca 35 EM is a viewfinder camera for 35mm film with a built-in light meter, made in Japan by Sanei Sangyō K.K.
